description.value:
You conjure a dark cloud above the battlefield from which leaps a massive giant of jagged bone. This skeletal giant usually appears as a massive form of the caster's ancestry. The giant occupies the space of a Huge creature and has a Speed of 40 feet.

Arrive Earthshaking Entrance The giant lands on the ground with a resounding crash, shaking the earth with its weight. Creatures on the ground in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:20] must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Prone].

Failure The creature is knocked prone and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Clumsy]{Clumsy 1} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is knocked prone and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Clumsy]{Clumsy 2} for 1 round.

Depart Terrible Blows The skeletal giant reaches out with its great hands and attempts to flatten its master's foes. Up to 2 different targets within 30 feet of the giant take @Damage[6d6[bludgeoning]] damage (basic Reflex save).

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

duration.value: until the end of your next turn
